messages:
support-alex: Customer (Acme Corp) reporting missing audit entries during an outage window; they see 503s for /v1/generate and say retention policy shows gaps. Need ISO evidence + repro.
ellen-security: can you share the exact time range and any request ids? also, did they publish a PII dataset to the API or was it normal traffic?
support-alex: timeline from the customer: 2026-03-15T02:12:00Z -> 02:26:00Z. Example request id they provided: `req_8b9f2d3c`. They sent a small repro curl that sometimes returns 503.
support-alex: curl repro snippet they used:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: req_8b9f2d3c" -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"input": "test"}'
```
sanjay-eng: noted. Can you grab the server-side trace for that request id? run `rdw-cli traces get --id req_8b9f2d3c --since 2026-03-15T02:00Z` and paste the last 2kb of the trace. If 503s correlate with kernel OOM or HSM timeouts we'll see it.
maya-platform: FYI we had a scheduled KMS key rotation in prod at 2026-03-15T02:10Z as part of ticket #PLT-4821. Rotation completed at 02:13Z, no errors in the KMS control plane but HSM vendor reported a short flapping session 02:11:30Z-02:12:40Z.
support-alex: whoops ok that aligns with customer's window. @ellen-security does a short HSM flip count as a possible reason for missing writes to the audit store? We need the ISO mapping for the evidence bundle (customer will require mapping to Annex A controls).
ellen-security: yes — HSM/KMS interruptions can cause delayed cryptographic operations which may lead to transient failures if retries aren't fully idempotent. For ISO27001 mapping include Annex A control references for:
- cryptographic controls (A.10.1)
- logging and monitoring (A.12.4)
- availability management (A.12.1)
Also include the change management ticket, KMS rotation logs, HSM vendor incident report, and audit DB write logs.
support-alex: copy. I'll collect:
- change ticket PLT-4821
- KMS rotation logs (console export)
- HSM vendor incident email (vendor-case-993)
- raw audit DB rows for request ids between 02:05-02:30Z (we'll show missing vs delayed rows)
- app traces from `rdw-cli` for `req_8b9f2d3c`
- customer repro curl + response headers (they capture `x-request-id` + `x-server-time`)
sanjay-eng: for reproducing locally, run the load scenario with injected KMS latency using `tox` mode: `./scripts/inject_kms_latency.sh 1000 10` then replay requests with `ab -n 200 -c 10 -H "X-Request-ID: repro-<n>"` — that'll surface race conditions.
support-alex: good repro plan, will run on a staging branch and attach logs. Also preparing an "evidence package" for ISO reviewers. What naming convention do we want for the zip?
gretchen-compliance: name it `evidence_iso27001_AcmeCorp_20260315_<thread_ts>.zip` and include a manifest.txt with itemized mapping to Annex A controls and a short risk statement + exception duration if any. Also include a signed attestation from the KMS vendor if they can provide one.
support-alex: ack. I'll assemble and upload to the secure evidence bucket, then share a download link and the manifest.
oncall-bot: Incident handover created: IH-20260315-78 (paged to security oncall).
ellen-security: mitigation suggestion for recency: enable forced fsync of audit writes for the subset of endpoints that require audit guarantees and add a short-term alert for missing sequence numbers. We'll review long-term fix after the RCA.
support-alex: will do the forced fsync change as a canary on staging. tagging @sanjay-eng for rollout plan. I'll update thread when the evidence zip is ready. :thumbsup:
